document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You  notice  light  tracks  through  the  woods.  On  closer 
examination,  you  think  they  were  left  by  moccasin-clad 
humans. You guess that the travelers are Indigenous people—
probably one that has had little contact with traders.

To follow the tracks, go to 559. To attempt to avoid the travelers, 
go to 572.
